newsitem.title: USA: Philly councilwoman proposes property tax aid.
newsitem.headline: Philly councilwoman proposes property tax aid.

text.p: Philadelphia City Councilwoman Marian Tasco has called on the city to provide help for seniors with property tax problems.

The councilwoman said she wants mobile teams formed to help seniors given target letters for non-payment of taxes. Tasco said she's worried that private collection agencies will harass the seniors for money once tax liens are sold.
The city is planning a $180 million tax lien sale, which involves turning over the rights to collect delinquent property taxes to more aggressive collection agencies.
